title: Matching information across sections
source: Language Learning Hub · original V4.4 teaching draft, not an external textbook
goal: Apply matching information across sections in an original academic-English context and explain reasoning in coherent English
context: 跨多个小节定位不同类型信息，先找功能再核对细节。
grammar: 题目可能问 limitation、example、definition 或 recommendation。定位后检查整句而非只匹配名词；同一关键词可能出现在多个小节并承担不同功能。
common_mistake: 找到 survey 一词不意味着找到调查的局限；必须读出限制内容。

examples.text: Section A defines a community survey as a structured collection of residents' views.
examples.note: 原文例句：结合本课知识讲解，辨认表达的功能与适用条件。

examples.text: It explains that a shared question set makes answers easier to compare.
examples.note: 原文例句：结合本课知识讲解，辨认表达的功能与适用条件。

examples.note: 原文例句：结合本课知识讲解，辨认表达的功能与适用条件。

examples.text: Because people who stayed at home were not approached, the responses may underrepresent them.
examples.note: 原文例句：结合本课知识讲解，辨认表达的功能与适用条件。

reading: Section A defines a community survey as a structured collection of residents' views. It explains that a shared question set makes answers easier to compare. Section B describes a pilot in which volunteers distributed forms at a weekend market. Because people who stayed at home were not approached, the responses may underrepresent them. Section C recommends combining face-to-face distribution with an accessible remote option. It also advises reporting who was not reached, rather than presenting the sample as the entire community.
listening_script: Section A defines a community survey as a structured collection of residents' views. It explains that a shared question set makes answers easier to compare. Section B describes a pilot in which volunteers distributed forms at a weekend market. Because people who stayed at home were not approached, the responses may underrepresent them. Section C recommends combining face-to-face distribution with an accessible remote option. It also advises reporting who was not reached, rather than presenting the sample as the entire community.
listening_label: 原创文本脚本；可用设备 TTS 练习，未配对真人或教材音频

questions.prompt: Which section identifies a limitation in recruitment ?
questions.explanation: 在家的人未被接触，明确描述抽样覆盖问题。

questions.prompt: Where is a methodological recommendation located ?
questions.explanation: combining 和 reporting 是行动建议。

pronunciation: sentence stress; connected speech; intelligibility without a total score。先按意群朗读，再用选词面板练习；浏览器转写不能证明音素正确。
production: Produce an original spoken explanation plus a written reflection demonstrating matching information across sections
self_review: 核对任务是否回答完整、信息是否有原文证据、目标结构是否准确。记录一次修改及理由；开放题允许不同的有据答案，不计算官方等级分数。
